parts:
Hi,
I am trying to run a syntax that I already used in the past but I keep receiving the message:

Error in if (n.from.graph <= 0) { : missing value where TRUE/FALSE needed
In addition: Warning message:
In inla.read.graph.ascii.internal(..., size.only = size.only) :
  NAs introduced by coercion

I don't understand what is happening. I checked the files and there is any cell without values.
It seems that it is missing some information on my syntax but I don´t understand what.
Bellow is the code I've run:

> obitos1519.RPM<-data.frame(region=1:dim(obitos1519)[1],region.struct=1:dim(obitos1519)[1],observados= obitos1519$O_prematuro1519,esperados= obitos1519$E_prematuro1519)

> formula2 <- observados ~ f(region.struct,model="besag",graph="C:/UC_Atlas RPMS/Indicadores_Fev22/teste.inla",hyper=list(theta=list(prior="logtgaussian",param=c(0,0.0001))))+f(region,verbose = TRUE,model="iid",hyper=list(theta=list(prior="logtgaussian",param=c(0,0.0001))))

> resultado2 <- inla(formula2,family="poisson",data= obitos1519.RPM,E= obitos1519.RPM$esperados,control.compute=list(dic=T,cpo=TRUE),control.predictor=list(compute=TRUE,cdf=c(log(1))))


I also checked my graph (attached) but there is no region with 0 neighbourhoods so I don't understand whats wrong...

Can some one help me? 

For sure it will be a very dummy problem but I was not able to figure out so far.


Best regards,

Claudia

inla.upgrade() is in the package, so if you dont have loaded INLA
package, its not there. btw, it does not works for windows as the
package needs to be detached when updating.

remove the package and follow the instructions on r-inla.org, like


install.packages("INLA",repos=c(getOption("repos"),INLA="https://inla.r-inla-download.org/R/testing
"), dep=TRUE)
